# netbox_device_module_bays (Data Source)

Retrieves all device module bays from NetBox. Narrow the result with filter blocks and cap it with limit.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_device_module_bays" "example" {
  filter {
    name  = "device_id"
    value = "1"
  }
}

output "device_module_bays" {
  value = data.netbox_device_module_bays.example.module_bays
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (Block Set) Filters that select which items are returned. Each filter is a name/value pair. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--filter))
- `limit` (Number) The maximum number of items to return. Defaults to 0, which returns all items. Defaults to `0`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `module_bays` (List of Object) The module bays of the device module bays. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--module_bays))

Required:

- `value` (String) The value of the field to filter by.
